recommendations.proposed_action: Examine transaction logs for discrepancies between debit records and credit confirmations. Identify whether issues are payment processing, notification, or reconciliation problems.
recommendations.rationale: High severity reports of money disappearing indicate potential data integrity or communication failures in the payment pipeline. This requires immediate investigation.
recommendations.unknowns: Whether the money is lost or merely misreported. Which payment gateways or bank partners are affected. How many transactions are impacted.
recommendations.validation_step: Query transaction database for payments debited but not credited within expected timeframes. Cross-check with bank reconciliation reports and payment provider logs.
hypotheses_to_test: Are failed or delayed payments concentrated among specific payment methods or bank partners?

recommendations.validation_step: Survey users who reported fee confusion about which products and at what step they expected to see fees. Audit current fee disclosure UI for all products.

recommendations.title: Unwanted auto debit not canceling and duplicate charges
recommendations.user_problem: Users report inability to cancel auto debit subscriptions through the app, resulting in unexpected charges before scheduled dates and missing notifications.
recommendations.proposed_action: Fix the auto debit cancellation functionality in the app to ensure requests are processed immediately. Verify subscription state changes are reflected correctly and payment timing matches user expectations.
recommendations.rationale: Users describe concrete failure: cancellation requests do not remove the auto debit, yet payments still occur. This is a defect in the cancellation flow.
recommendations.unknowns: Whether the cancellation request fails silently or errors back to user. Whether the backend processes cancellations but the app does not reflect them. How widespread the issue is.
recommendations.validation_step: Reproduce auto debit cancellation flow end-to-end. Check backend logs for cancellation success vs app-side state mismatches. Review recent changes to subscription management code.
hypotheses_to_test: Is the cancellation request failing in the backend or just not updating in the app UI?
Are charges occurring before scheduled dates across all auto debit types or specific ones?
